notes.title: Happy holidays!
notes.content:
Good afternoon, dear friends.
I usually release one theme every half a year, but now I don't have time and made only one boss.
In the future I will add new themes, I will fix bugs, but for now I wish you Happy Holidays and wish you a festive mood!!!!

p.s.
Thank you for your support and for running my game.
